callees.name: try_codegraph_init
callees.pre_condition: worktree_dir is a path to a directory containing source files to be indexed by CodeGraph.
callees.post_condition: Initializes a CodeGraph index for the source tree at worktree_dir. Returns nothing on success; on failure, subsequent CodeGraph queries return None.

callees.name: _codegraph_functions_by_file
callees.pre_condition: worktree_dir is a directory path whose source tree has been successfully indexed by CodeGraph. lang_keys is a collection of language key strings drawn from the values of file_languages.
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict mapping each source file path to a dict of function data keyed by function name. Returns None when the CodeGraph index is unavailable or cannot be queried.

callees.name: _codegraph_legacy_coverage
callees.pre_condition: worktree_dir is a directory path. functions is the dict returned by _codegraph_functions_by_file. file_languages is a dict mapping relative file paths to language keys.
callees.post_condition: Returns a coverage dict indicating, for each file in file_languages, which function names are present in the CodeGraph functions dict and which are absent, allowing the caller to identify functions that require legacy (non-CodeGraph) extraction.
